15 Sustainable Black Friday Deals on Eco-Friendly Clothing & More (2026)

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 10:41
Instaread

If you caught our first guide on how to shop Black Friday without fast fashion, you already know why mindless shopping doesn’t align with conscious style. Now, let’s turn intention into action.

Below is a hand-picked selection of the best sustainable Black Friday deals and Green Friday sales you can shop right now—curated from ethical, transparent brands that align with your values. Whether you’re gifting or stocking up on essentials, these conscious discounts help you save and support the good guys.

Think of this as your shortlist: where ethics meet opportunity. Scroll past the deals for a link to our full roundup of 25+ sustainable brand sales.

Top 15 Sustainable Black Friday Deals

Here are a few of our favorites to help you get started. These deals tend to change quickly, so explore what feels right for you.

A Note About Deal Updates:
We’ll be updating this roundup regularly through the end of the month as new Black Friday promotions roll out. Some brands haven’t announced their Black Friday deals yet, so for now we list their best current sale and add the Black Friday offer as soon as it goes live.

For a few brands—like 8000Kicks—we normally share exclusive Eco-Stylist reader codes (such as 10% off). But during Black Friday, their sitewide deals match or beat our code. We always highlight the best available savings for you. Transparency first.

Eco-Stylist is reader-supported. If you make a purchase using our links, we may earn a commission. We only feature fashion brands that pass our sustainable brand criteria. Learn more here.

1) Toad&Co — Up to 70% Off Everything (Nov 24–30)

Sustainable outdoor-inspired apparel with serious comfort. Great for layering pieces, cozy winter wear, and soft eco-friendly knits.

The deal: from November 24 through 30, Toad&Co’s once-a-year Gifting Good Holiday Sale takes up to 70% off everything, no code needed.

Shopping early? Right now through December 17, pick any three full-price items and get $30 off your order, no code needed. (This offer pauses during the November 24–30 sale.)

Shop the Toad&Co sale

Our experience: Our team has worn Toad&Co’s Marigold Tiered Midi Skirt and one of their women’s sweaters. Both are comfortable, easy to care for, and easy to pair with outfits.

2) Pact — Up to 70% Off Organic Cotton Basics

Organic cotton basics made in Fair Trade Certified factories—perfect for stocking up on everyday essentials or gifting high-quality staples.

Right now you can save up to 70% off Pact’s sale styles. We’ll add their Black Friday deal here as soon as it’s announced.

Shop the Pact sale

Our experience: Our team wears Pact’s organic cotton underwear, and it’s comfortable and holds up well. I’ve also reviewed their men’s pants and henleys. Watch my Pact review.

3) Outerknown — Up to 50% Off Surf-Inspired Sustainable Classics

One of the most trusted names in responsible men’s and women’s casual clothing. This sale includes best-sellers and deep discounts on past-season pieces.

Right now you can save up to 50% off Outerknown’s sale styles. We’ll add their Black Friday deal as soon as it’s live. 

Shop the Outerknown sale

Our experience: I own Outerknown swim trunks, jeans, and a wool blazer. The quality is really high and the trunks are the nicest I’ve ever owned.

4) Taylor Stitch — Up to 40% Off Rugged, Responsible Menswear

Well-crafted, durable menswear made using ethical factories and responsible materials. This is a strong moment to buy clothes backed by their Long Haul Guarantee.

Right now you can get up to 40% off Last Call menswear styles. We’ll add their Black Friday deal as soon as it’s announced.

Shop the Taylor Stitch sale

Our experience: I own Taylor Stitch jeans, suits, shirts, pants, and jackets. Every piece is built to last for years, and some are the best clothes I own. Watch my Taylor Stitch review.

5) prAna — 25% Off Select Styles + $50 Off $200 (Through Nov 17)

Activewear, outdoor apparel, and everyday basics made with materials like organic cotton, hemp, and recycled fibers, much of it sewn in Fair Trade Certified factories. Great for travel, hiking, and everyday layers.

Right now through November 17, get 25% off select prAna styles, plus $50 off when you spend $200. We’ll add their Black Friday deal as soon as it’s live.

Shop the prAna sale

Our experience: I’ve worn prAna shirts, shorts, and their Stretch Zion pants. Watch my prAna review.

6) Subset — Up to 50% Off Socks, Robes & Their Advent Calendar

Comfort-first, minimalist essentials built to last. Includes bras, underwear, and loungewear made from sustainable materials.

Right now, ahead of Black Friday, save up to 50% off socks, robes, and Subset’s Advent Calendar. We’ll add their Black Friday deal as soon as it’s live.

Shop the Subset sale

7) MATE the Label — Up to 50% Off Clean, Non-Toxic Essentials

Earth-friendly women’s essentials made with clean, non-toxic materials. A great moment to grab elevated basics and soft everyday layers.

Right now you can save up to 50% off select MATE styles. We’ll add their Black Friday deal as soon as it’s live.

Shop the MATE sale

8) Beckett Simonon — 2 Pairs of Handcrafted Shoes From $259

Timeless leather shoes and boots handcrafted in ethical workshops in Bogotá, Colombia, using full-grain leather from a Leather Working Group Gold-rated tannery.

For Black Friday and Cyber Monday, get two pairs of shoes for $359 in men’s styles or $259 in women’s styles. It’s an easy way to cover yourself and a gift.

Shop the Beckett Simonon bundle

Our experience: I own Beckett Simonon’s Maxwell Trainers. They’re my nicest sneakers, beautiful and very well made, and what I reach for whenever I want to look sharp.

9) Tentree — Up to 50% Off Planet-Positive Casualwear

Eco-friendly casualwear backed by real impact—each purchase plants trees. Cozy basics, outerwear, and everyday essentials on sale.

Right now you can save up to 50% off sale styles. Every purchase plants 10 trees too! We’ll add their Black Friday deal as soon as it’s live.

Shop the Tentree sale

10) SAOLA — 20% Off Lightweight, Vegan Everyday Sneakers

Lightweight, low-impact, vegan footwear made from recycled and bio-based materials.

Right now you can save 20% off your entire order with code SAOLA20. We’ll add their Black Friday deal as soon as it’s live.

Shop the SAOLA sale

11) Brilliant Earth — Free Diamond Jewelry with Purchases of Ethical Fine Jewelry

Thoughtfully sourced, responsibly crafted fine jewelry made with recycled precious metals and ethically sourced gemstones. A beautiful moment to save on meaningful gifts that reflect your values.

Right now you can get free diamond earrings with purchases over $500. Click through for their current offers. We’ll update this with their Black Friday offer as soon as it’s live.

Shop the Brilliant Earth offer

12) KNOWN SUPPLY — Size Inclusive Fair Trade Apparel (Deal Coming Soon)

Fair Trade Certified apparel where every garment is signed by the maker. High-quality tees, hoodies, and everyday basics that honor the people who made them.

KNOWN SUPPLY hasn’t announced their Black Friday deal yet. Last year they offered 30% off all clothes, including sale items. We’ll add this year’s deal as soon as it’s live.

Shop KNOWN SUPPLY

Our experience: In 2022 we collaborated with KNOWN SUPPLY on custom organic cotton Eco-Stylist hats, with the maker’s name on every tag. I own one and wear it almost every day.

13) 8000Kicks — Up to 45% Off Durable Hemp Footwear

Durable, water-resistant hemp sneakers designed for comfort and low impact. Great for travel, daily wear, and anyone who loves eco-forward innovation.

For Black Friday, the more you shop, the more you save:

  • Spend $50 – Get 10% off
  • Spend $100 – Get 20% off
  • Spend $250 – Get 30% off
  • Spend $500 – Get 40% off
  • Spend $600 – Get 45% off

Shop the 8000Kicks sale

Our experience: I’ve worn two pairs of 8000Kicks shoes, the Trekkers and the Runners. Both are super lightweight, comfortable, and durable, and the Runners are my everyday shoe. Watch my 8000Kicks review.

14) ColieCo — 20% Off Handmade, Made-to-Order Lingerie (Nov 27–30)

Ethically handcrafted lingerie and swimwear made to order using deadstock and eco-conscious fabrics. Perfect for conscious shoppers who value slow fashion and personalization.

From November 27 through 30, take 20% off everything on ColieCo’s site, no code needed.

Shop ColieCo

15) PlushBeds — $1,500 Off Organic Mattresses + an Extra $100 Off

Organic latex mattresses made since 2008 in a certified organic factory in Camarillo, California, using GOLS-certified organic latex and GOTS-certified organic cotton and wool. A top choice for upgrading your sleep sustainably.

PlushBeds’ Early Black Friday Sale is live now: $1,500 off all adult bedroom mattresses, plus $799 worth of organic bedding (pillows, a sheet set, and a mattress protector) for just $99 with any adult bedroom mattress. That brings their best-selling Botanical Bliss organic latex mattress down to $1,499. Toppers, pillows, and bedding are also 25% off.

Bonus for Eco-Stylist readers: get an extra $100 off your mattress with code ECO100, which stacks with the sale.

Shop the PlushBeds sale

Want the details first? Read our PlushBeds Botanical Bliss review.

From eco-leather boots to compostable accessories, that page lists the full spectrum of options—including brands you may not know yet—but should.

How to Choose the Right Sustainable Black Friday Deal for You

Since you’re already familiar with the “how” from our earlier guide, here are three quick filters to pick wisely:

  • Need vs. want: If you didn’t plan for it, maybe skip it.
  • Longevity: Will you wear it five years from now?
  • Brand mission: Does the brand transparently show its values, workers, and materials? If you’re shopping Eco-Stylist certified brands you’ve already got this one covered.

Why These Deals Matter

By shopping the right sales, you support brands that do things differently—fair wages, transparent supply chains, eco-friendly materials. When you buy from them during the season’s biggest promotional moment, you amplify their impact.

Wrap-Up: Shopping Smart in the Sale Season

They say Black Friday is about the biggest discounts. We say: it’s about the biggest opportunity—to shift how fashion works.

So if you’re going to shop this weekend, do it with purpose. Support the brands changing the game. Skip the ones that only change the price tag.

Share This Guide. Grow the Impact.

If this roundup helped you find better sustainable Black Friday deals—or made shopping sustainably feel a little easier—share it with someone who’s trying to make more conscious choices, too.

Real change scales when we learn together.
